title: melicytus ramiflorus subsp. oblongifolius
intro: Melicytus ramiflorus subsp. oblongifolius, commonly known as New Zealand Matipo or New Zealand Matipo shrub, is a plant species native to New Zealand. This plant has been traditionally used in traditional Māori medicine, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Melicytus ramiflorus subsp. oblongifolius include anti-inflammatory and antiviral activities, which may contribute to its use in the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
